entries.reason: the release's ImageIO decodes when an image is first drawn and has no option to decode at creation
entries.effect: the key is the string ImageIO gives it and the release's CGImageSourceCreateImageAtIndex ignores it, so the image is made as it is without the option and decoded when first used
entries.source: the host's own ImageIO, held against the port by tests/backports/host/imageio and the same test on a device running 6.1.3
